title: Easy Small Talk: How about you?

vocabulary.meaning_en: going to other places or countries
a big country in North America
the child of your uncle or aunt
a phone or computer call where you can see the person
vocabulary.example: I talk to my aunt on video calls.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a special day or a time when you don't work
a spicy dish with sauce, often with rice
time to relax and not work
vocabulary.note_ar: take a rest = يأخذ قسطًا من الراحة
vocabulary.example: I take a rest on Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: go to shops to buy things

vocabulary.example: I like going to the park.

fine_lines.title: How about you? vs What about you?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: العبارتان بنفس المعنى تقريبًا: نرد السؤال على الشخص الآخر (وماذا عنك؟).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the same: we ask the other person the same question.

examples.sentence: I like tea. How about you?
I want to visit Canada. What about you?

fine_lines.title: often vs not really
fine_lines.explanation_ar: often تعني كثيرًا. Not really جواب لطيف يعني "ليس كثيرًا" أو "لا".
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Often" = many times. "Not really" is a soft way to say no.

examples.sentence: Do you see your cousin often?
Not really, only on video calls.

expressions.example: Do you like traveling? Yes, I love it.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you agree or feel the same.

expressions.phrase: I want to go to Italy one day.
expressions.meaning_ar: أريد أن أذهب إلى إيطاليا يومًا ما.
expressions.example: I want to visit Mecca one day.
I'm a teacher. How about you?
Do you like coffee? Not really.

expressions.phrase: Good food always makes me happy.
expressions.example: A walk in the park always makes me happy.
How was your morning? Good, thanks!
Do you study every day? Almost every day.
Park or shopping? Both sound fun!

grammar.title: Do you like...? — Yes, I do. / Not really.
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن الذوق بـ Do you like + اسم أو فعل بـ ing؟ والجواب: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. / Not really.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: Do you like + noun / verb-ing? Answer: Yes, I do / Not really.
examples: Do you like traveling? Yes, I love it.
Do you like eggs? Yes, I do!
Do you like coffee? Not really. I like tea.

grammar.title: Past simple: How was...? / I had... / I ate...
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن الصباح الذي مضى: How was your morning? I had coffee. I ate rice and eggs. (have → had، eat → ate)
grammar.explanation_en: Talk about the past: How was...? I had... I ate... (had, ate are irregular).

grammar.title: want to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: want to + الفعل لنعبّر عن رغبة: I want to go to Italy. I want to visit Canada.
grammar.explanation_en: want to + base verb for wishes.
examples: I want to go to Italy one day.

questions.question: Do you like traveling? — Yes, I ___.
I like tea. — ___ (I like tea, too.)
Do you like coffee? — ___ I like tea.
questions.explanation_ar: Not really = لا ليس كثيرًا، لذلك يقول إنه يحب الشاي.
questions.explanation_en: "Not really" = no; so they prefer tea.

questions.question: How was your morning? — Good! I ___ coffee and toast.
I ___ rice and eggs this morning.
Do you study every day? — ___ every day.
questions.explanation_ar: almost every day = تقريبًا كل يوم.

questions.question: A call where you can see the person is a ___.
My cousin lives in Canada. Your cousin is...
choices: the child of your uncle or aunt
questions.explanation_en: A cousin is the child of your uncle or aunt.
